revenue.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

net_income.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

free_cash_flow.notes: Operating cash flow TTM minus capex TTM. Capex is treated as a positive cash outflow.

ebitda.notes: Proxy EBITDA: operating income plus depreciation/amortization where SEC facts are available.

debt.notes: Latest available SEC debt fact. This may include capital/finance lease obligations depending on the SEC tag.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

listing_shares.notes: Latest open/free price multiplied by SEC diluted weighted-average shares.

forward_eps_public.notes: Yahoo expected EPS per listed share in USD; estimate methodology is not independently verified.

forward_eps_proxy.notes: forward_eps_proxy: Positive trailing EPS and a usable EPS growth rate were unavailable.

revenue_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter YoY growth computed from reported Q2 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Q2/Q3 single-quarter values may be derived from year-to-date 10-Q/6-K facts; Q4 may be derived from annual facts minus Q3 year-to-date facts.

revenue_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter 3-year CAGR computed from reported Q2 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. eps_gaap_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_cagr_3y.notes: eps_cagr_3y: GAAP EPS turned positive from a loss-making comparison period (latest 1.22, comparison -1.71); 3-year GAAP EPS CAGR is not meaningful.

free_cash_flow.notes: Latest-quarter free_cash_flow: Quarterly free cash flow computed as operating cash flow minus capex.

fcf_margin.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

roe.notes: Latest-quarter roe: Annualized quarterly net income divided by quarter-end equity.

roic.notes: Latest-quarter roic: Proxy annualized quarterly ROIC: operating income divided by quarter-end invested capital. No tax adjustment is applied.

revenue.notes: Quarterly revenue YoY growth for Q2 versus the same fiscal quarter last year.
revenue.formula: (quarter revenue / same fiscal quarter prior-year revenue - 1) × 100

momentum.notes: Existing thresholds: accelerating ≥3 pp; decelerating ≤−3 pp; otherwise steady.
momentum.formula: median(latest 3 quarterly YoY growth rates) − median(preceding 3), pp

fcf_margin.formula: (TTM operating cash flow − TTM capex) / TTM revenue × 100
warnings: FY2026 Q2: quarterly FCF margin deteriorated -52.35 pp YoY; assess materiality. This is separate from TTM margin.

forward_pe.notes: Yahoo expected EPS per listed share in USD; estimate methodology is not independently verified.
forward_pe.formula: current price / sourced annual forward EPS
warnings: A positive sourced annual EPS estimate, identifiable forecast horizon, currency and estimate date are required; quote and estimate must be no older than seven days. Historical EPS extrapolation is excluded.

balance_sheet.formula: cash and cash equivalents − total debt; investments excluded
warnings: Net cash/debt requires unrestricted cash equivalents and complete compatible debt. Investments are excluded; inspect component definitions.
